# newreleases_tag (Resource)

Manages a tag used to group tracked projects on newreleases.io.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "newreleases_tag" "infra" {
  name = "infrastructure"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tag name. Renaming updates the tag in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Tag ID assigned by newreleases.io.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By tag ID
terraform import newreleases_tag.infra 33f1db7254b9
```
